Done — I refreshed the UI and split the storefront into smaller components without changing the app’s behavior.

What I changed:
- Gave the app a more modern visual treatment:
  - updated hero section styling
  - softened cards/inputs with cleaner spacing and shadows
  - improved the overall page layout and footer
- Broke the main storefront UI into smaller files:
  - `src/components/StorefrontHero.tsx`
  - `src/components/CatalogControls.tsx`
  - `src/components/ProductsGrid.tsx`
  - `src/components/Footer.tsx`
- Simplified `src/App.tsx` so it now mostly composes those pieces

Notes:
- I didn’t alter any app features or flows.
- I attempted a build check, but the container doesn’t have the Vite binary available, so I couldn’t verify with `npm run build` here.
